methodology: Approximate manual full-object silhouette traces drawn by visual inspection of EXIF-oriented 320x213 input PNGs and enlarged input-only inspection sheets. No reconstruction, camera solution, render, training result, RGB threshold, or automatic segmentation informed the traces. Foreground silhouettes exclude cast shadows, mounting supports, and visible/uncertain background openings. Deep cavities whose interior surfaces remain visible stay foreground unless explicitly excluded. Conservative two-pixel Chebyshev erosion is applied uniformly to the rasterized silhouette, including hole boundaries.
author: Codex GPT-6, manual image inspection
purpose: Evaluation only; never training or geometry input. Approximate annotations, not ground truth.
coordinateSystem: Normalized (x/320,y/213) in the EXIF-oriented annotation PNG; origin upper left.

rasterization.erosionMetric: Chebyshev; 5x5 minimum filter after polygon union and hole subtraction

limitations: Boundary vertices are approximate at 320px and may differ by several pixels from the browser resampling.
Two-pixel erosion removes a uniform uncertainty band, not selected interior patches.
Skull mounting junctions and cavity interiors are ambiguous; the mask conservatively excludes uncertain support/background regions.
Use these masks only with the stated limitations when interpreting masked SSIM/PSNR.
